description:
SFT Brain helps you create, organize, and review flashcards from ChatGPT.

After connecting your SFT Brain account, you can save question-and-answer cards, search existing flashcards, review due cards, record answers with AI feedback, save visual study widgets, and view learning progress.

Use it for studying, language learning, coding concepts, exam prep, and retaining information from conversations.

defaultPrompt: Create five flashcards about spaced repetition and save them to a new deck.
Show me the flashcards I need to review today and start a review session.
Summarize my learning progress and identify the topics that need more practice.
